run_get_all_states_tic_tac_toe: run the get_all_states example to get all states for tic_tac_toe game
run_get_all_states_with_players: run the get_all_states example with a custom number of players for the game
run_get_all_states_with_depth_limit: run the get_all_states example with a depth limit to stop traversal at a given depth
run_get_all_states_exclude_terminals: run the get_all_states example excluding terminal states from the result
run_get_all_states_exclude_chance: run the get_all_states example excluding chance states from the result
